definitions.explanation: To forcefully push someone or something away from oneself.
To push with enough force to make someone fall or stagger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばす。
⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧な⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばした。
examples.english: I shoved the luggage that was in the way.
He shoved people aside and pushed forward through the crowd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばす。
⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばして⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I ended up knocking her down in anger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばされて、⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: I was shoved with full force and fell to the ground.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to thrust, to poke) + ⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧ (to make fly, to send away)

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive) - takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the person/thing being pushed

ASPECT (ている):
{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates the action is in progress.

REGISTER:
Neutral. Can be used in both casual and formal contexts.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{突|つ}き{刺|さ}す→突き刺す：06088_tsukisasu⟧: to stab
- ⟦{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす→蹴り飛ばす：06137_keritobasu⟧: to kick away
- ⟦{殴|なぐ}り{倒|たお}す→殴り倒す：06212_naguritaosu⟧: to knock down with a punch

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばす: to push a person away
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばす: to shove with all one's strength
